"""Synthetic external receipt-graph fixtures; no native operations are executed."""

import copy
import importlib
import json
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

import common
import lineage
import yaml
from assemble_review import RUBRICS


def put(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n")
    return common.bind(path)


class LineageTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="lyxose-v2-lineage-", dir="/private/tmp")
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.work = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.root = self.work / "root"
        self.root.mkdir()
        self.addCleanup(patch.stopall)
        patch.object(lineage, "ROOT", self.root).start()
        self.assembly_dir = self.work / "assembly"
        self.native_dir = self.work / "native"
        self.assembly_dir.mkdir()
        self.native_dir.mkdir()
        for rel in set(RUBRICS) | {
            common.TARGET,
            common.PAGE,
            "pages/downloads/nodes.tsv",
            "pages/downloads/edges.tsv",
            "context.txt",
        }:
            p = self.root / rel
            p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            p.write_text("fixture input\n")
        (self.root / common.TARGET).write_bytes((common.ROOT / common.TARGET).read_bytes())
        self.tested = {
            rel: common.sha(self.root / rel)
            for rel in set(RUBRICS) | {common.TARGET, "context.txt"}
        }
        log = self.work / "gate.log"
        log.write_bytes(b"fixture: no execution\n")
        gate = self.work / "gates.json"
        put(
            gate,
            {
                "receipts": [
                    {"name": name, "stdout": common.bind(log), "stderr": common.bind(log)}
                    for name in common.GATES
                ]
            },
        )
        adoption = self.work / "adoption.json"
        put(adoption, {"fixture": True})
        self.cfg = {"gates": common.bind(gate), "adoption": common.bind(adoption)}
        config = self.work / "config.json"
        put(config, self.cfg)
        # Only upstream actual gate/preservation checks are isolated. Their real
        # config is separately replayed read-only by validate_v2.py.
        patch.object(lineage, "input_config", return_value=self.cfg).start()
        patch.object(
            lineage,
            "check_inputs",
            return_value=(
                {"baseline": {}},
                {},
                {},
                {},
                self.tested,
            ),
        ).start()
        rows = []
        archived = []
        for index, item in enumerate(lineage.expected_archive_entries(self.cfg)):
            prepared = self.work / "prepared" / (str(index) + ".json")
            prepared.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            if item["mode"] == "lossless_utf8":
                put(prepared, common.wrapper(item["original"]["path"]))
            else:
                prepared.write_bytes(Path(item["original"]["path"]).read_bytes())
            rows.append({**item, "prepared": common.bind(prepared)})
            dest = self.root / item["destination"]
            dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            dest.write_bytes(prepared.read_bytes())
            archived.append({"relative_path": item["destination"], **common.bind(dest)})
        self.plan_path = self.work / "plan.json"
        put(
            self.plan_path,
            {
                "status": "actual_receipts_verified_pending_root_archive",
                "root": str(self.root),
                "config": common.bind(config),
                "mappings": rows,
            },
        )
        self.archive_path = self.work / "archive.json"
        put(
            self.archive_path,
            {"status": "archived", "plan": common.bind(self.plan_path), "files": archived},
        )
        required = (
            set(self.tested)
            | set(RUBRICS)
            | {
                common.PAGE,
                "pages/downloads/nodes.tsv",
                "pages/downloads/edges.tsv",
            }
            | {row["relative_path"] for row in archived}
        )
        input_list = self.assembly_dir / "native-inspection-inputs.json"
        put(input_list, sorted(required - {common.TARGET}))
        source = {
            "git_revision": common.BASE,
            "state": "working_tree",
            "inputs": [
                {
                    "path": rel,
                    "sha256": common.sha(self.root / rel),
                    "role": "target" if rel == common.TARGET else "context",
                }
                for rel in sorted(required)
            ],
        }
        self.doc = {
            "review_id": "20261012T030000Z-fixture",
            "reviewer": {"independence": "self_review"},
            "source": source,
            "targets": [{"target_id": common.TARGET_ID, "path": common.TARGET}],
        }
        review = self.assembly_dir / "completed-review.yaml"
        review.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(self.doc))
        inspect_binding = self.make_execution(
            self.assembly_dir,
            "inspect",
            [
                str(common.PACKAGE / "inspect_with_inputs.py"),
                "--input-list",
                str(input_list),
                "--targets",
                str(common.PACKAGE / "targets.yaml"),
            ],
            json.dumps(
                {"status": "inspection_only", "source": source, "targets": self.doc["targets"]}
            ),
            0,
        )
        self.assembly_path = self.assembly_dir / "assembly.json"
        self.assembly = {
            "status": "assembled_pending_native_validation_and_root_save",
            "maintained_writes": False,
            "target": common.bind(self.root / common.TARGET),
            "archive_receipt": common.bind(self.archive_path),
            "config": common.bind(config),
            "review": common.bind(review),
            "review_id": self.doc["review_id"],
            "inspection_inputs": common.bind(input_list),
            "inspect_receipt": inspect_binding,
            "source_inputs": len(required),
        }
        put(self.assembly_path, self.assembly)
        review_path = self.root / "reviews/structured" / self.doc["review_id"] / "review.yaml"
        review_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        review_path.write_bytes(review.read_bytes())
        markdown = review_path.with_name("review.md")
        markdown.write_text("fixture rendered review\n")
        history = self.root / "history/records/l-lyxose-degradation/fixture.yaml"
        history.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        history.write_text("fixture native history\n")
        args = {
            "validate": ["scripts/record_review.py", "validate", str(review)],
            "save": ["scripts/record_review.py", "save", "--content", str(review)],
            "history": lineage.history_arguments(self.doc, review_path),
            "validate-history": ["scripts/validate_history.py", str(history)],
            "check": ["scripts/record_review.py", "check", "--base", common.BASE],
        }
        outputs = {
            "validate": json.dumps({"valid_reviews": 1}),
            "save": json.dumps({"review": str(review_path), "markdown": str(markdown)}),
            "history": str(history.relative_to(self.root)) + "\n",
            "validate-history": "fixture validation successful\n",
            "check": json.dumps({"valid_reviews": 102}),
        }
        receipts = {
            name: self.make_execution(self.native_dir, name, args[name], outputs[name], n)
            for n, name in enumerate(lineage.NATIVE_STEPS, 1)
        }
        self.completion_path = self.native_dir / "native-completion.json"
        self.completion = {
            "status": "saved_review_and_history_checked",
            "assembly": common.bind(self.assembly_path),
            "review_id": self.doc["review_id"],
            "canonical_yaml": common.bind(review_path),
            "canonical_markdown": common.bind(markdown),
            "history": common.bind(history),
            "check_result": {"valid_reviews": 102},
            "actual_receipts": receipts,
        }
        put(self.completion_path, self.completion)

    def make_execution(self, directory, label, arguments, stdout, second):
        out, err = directory / (label + ".stdout"), directory / (label + ".stderr")
        out.write_text(stdout)
        err.write_bytes(b"")
        return put(
            directory / (label + "-execution.json"),
            {
                "command": [common.PY, "-B", *arguments],
                "cwd": str(self.root),
                "environment": {
                    "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
                    "UV_NO_SYNC": "1",
                    "PYTHONPATH": str(self.root / "src") + ":" + str(self.root),
                },
                "started_at": f"2026-10-12T03:00:{second * 2:02d}Z",
                "finished_at": f"2026-10-12T03:00:{second * 2 + 1:02d}Z",
                "exit_code": 0,
                "stdout": common.bind(out),
                "stderr": common.bind(err),
            },
        )

    def completion_check(self):
        put(self.completion_path, self.completion)
        return lineage.verify_native_completion(self.completion_path)

    def change_execution(self, name, edit, inspect=False):
        binding = (
            self.assembly["inspect_receipt"]
            if inspect
            else self.completion["actual_receipts"][name]
        )
        value = common.read(binding["path"])
        edit(value)
        new = put(Path(binding["path"]), value)
        if inspect:
            self.assembly["inspect_receipt"] = new
            self.completion["assembly"] = put(self.assembly_path, self.assembly)
        else:
            self.completion["actual_receipts"][name] = new

    def test_positive_complete_lineage(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.completion_check()[0]["review_id"], self.doc["review_id"])

    def test_assembly_positive_before_any_saved_files(self):
        for key in ["canonical_yaml", "canonical_markdown", "history"]:
            Path(self.completion[key]["path"]).unlink()
        lineage.verify_assembly(self.assembly_path)

    def test_empty_native_receipts_rejected(self):
        self.completion["actual_receipts"] = {}
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            self.completion_check()

    def test_each_missing_native_step_rejected(self):
        saved = copy.deepcopy(self.completion)
        for name in lineage.NATIVE_STEPS:
            self.completion = copy.deepcopy(saved)
            del self.completion["actual_receipts"][name]
            with self.subTest(step=name), self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
                self.completion_check()

    def test_unrelated_native_receipt_rejected(self):
        self.completion["actual_receipts"]["unrelated"] = self.completion["actual_receipts"]["save"]
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            self.completion_check()

    def test_missing_inspect_rejected(self):
        del self.assembly["inspect_receipt"]
        self.completion["assembly"] = put(self.assembly_path, self.assembly)
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            self.completion_check()

    def test_wrong_native_command_rejected(self):
        self.change_execution("save", lambda r: r.update(command=[common.PY, "-B", "-c", "pass"]))
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            self.completion_check()

    def test_wrong_inspect_command_rejected(self):
        self.change_execution("inspect", lambda r: r.update(command=["unrelated"]), inspect=True)
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            self.completion_check()

    def test_wrong_cwd_rejected(self):
        self.change_execution("save", lambda r: r.update(cwd="/private/tmp"))
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            self.completion_check()

    def test_wrong_environment_rejected(self):
        self.change_execution("save", lambda r: r["environment"].update(UV_NO_SYNC="0"))
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            self.completion_check()

    def test_failed_native_receipt_rejected(self):
        self.change_execution("save", lambda r: r.update(exit_code=1))
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            self.completion_check()

    def test_out_of_order_receipt_rejected(self):
        self.change_execution(
            "check",
            lambda r: r.update(
                started_at="2026-10-12T02:00:00Z", finished_at="2026-10-12T02:00:01Z"
            ),
        )
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            self.completion_check()

    def test_redirected_stream_rejected(self):
        other = self.work / "old-save.stdout"
        other.write_text("{}")
        self.change_execution("save", lambda r: r.update(stdout=common.bind(other)))
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            self.completion_check()

    def test_changed_stream_rejected(self):
        (self.native_dir / "save.stdout").write_text("{}")
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            self.completion_check()

    def test_wrong_saved_output_rejected(self):
        p = self.native_dir / "save.stdout"
        put(
            p,
            {
                "review": str(self.root / "elsewhere.yaml"),
                "markdown": self.completion["canonical_markdown"]["path"],
            },
        )
        self.change_execution("save", lambda r: r.update(stdout=common.bind(p)))
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            self.completion_check()

    def test_wrong_history_output_rejected(self):
        p = self.native_dir / "history.stdout"
        p.write_text("../outside.yaml\n")
        self.change_execution("history", lambda r: r.update(stdout=common.bind(p)))
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            self.completion_check()

    def test_wrong_check_output_rejected(self):
        p = self.native_dir / "check.stdout"
        put(p, {"valid_reviews": 101})
        self.change_execution("check", lambda r: r.update(stdout=common.bind(p)))
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            self.completion_check()

    def test_thinned_inspection_inputs_rejected(self):
        p = self.assembly_dir / "native-inspection-inputs.json"
        self.assembly["inspection_inputs"] = put(p, [common.TARGET])
        self.completion["assembly"] = put(self.assembly_path, self.assembly)
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            self.completion_check()

    def test_changed_source_input_rejected(self):
        (self.root / "context.txt").write_text("changed\n")
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            self.completion_check()

    def test_archive_config_disagreement_rejected(self):
        self.assembly["config"] = common.bind(self.plan_path)
        self.completion["assembly"] = put(self.assembly_path, self.assembly)
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            self.completion_check()

    def test_missing_archived_file_rejected(self):
        receipt = common.read(self.archive_path)
        receipt["files"].pop()
        self.assembly["archive_receipt"] = put(self.archive_path, receipt)
        self.completion["assembly"] = put(self.assembly_path, self.assembly)
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            self.completion_check()

    def inventory_rows(self):
        return [
            {"relative_path": str(p.relative_to(self.root)), **common.bind(p)}
            for p in sorted(self.root.rglob("*"))
            if p.is_file()
        ]

    def test_current_inventory_positive(self):
        lineage.verify_current_inventory(self.inventory_rows())

    def test_redirected_file_binding_rejected(self):
        rows = self.inventory_rows()
        external = self.work / "context-old-copy.txt"
        external.write_bytes((self.root / "context.txt").read_bytes())
        (self.root / "context.txt").write_text("changed bytes\n")
        next(r for r in rows if r["relative_path"] == "context.txt")["path"] = str(external)
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            lineage.verify_current_inventory(rows)

    def test_duplicate_inventory_row_rejected(self):
        rows = self.inventory_rows()
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            lineage.verify_current_inventory(rows + rows[:1])

    def test_missing_inventory_row_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            lineage.verify_current_inventory(self.inventory_rows()[1:])

    def test_symlink_escape_rejected(self):
        external = self.work / "outside"
        external.write_text("outside\n")
        (self.root / "linked").symlink_to(external)
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            lineage.rooted(self.root / "linked")

    def test_destination_positive(self):
        lineage.destination_set(
            [common.DOSSIER + "/final-gates/new.json"], self.root / common.DOSSIER / "final-gates"
        )

    def test_duplicate_destinations_rejected_before_write(self):
        name = common.DOSSIER + "/final-gates/new.json"
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            lineage.destination_set([name, name], self.root / common.DOSSIER / "final-gates")
        self.assertFalse((self.root / name).exists())

    def test_ancestor_destinations_rejected_before_write(self):
        name = common.DOSSIER + "/final-gates/new"
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            lineage.destination_set(
                [name, name + "/child.json"], self.root / common.DOSSIER / "final-gates"
            )
        self.assertFalse((self.root / name).exists())

    def completion_archive_fixture(self):
        package = self.work / "helper-package"
        package.mkdir()
        script = package / "helper.py"
        script.write_bytes(b"pass\n\n")
        manifest = package / "artifact-manifest.json"
        put(manifest, {"artifacts": [{"relative_path": "helper.py", **common.bind(script)}]})
        put(package / "handoff.json", {"manifest": common.bind(manifest)})
        patch.object(lineage, "PACKAGE", package).start()
        rows = []
        for entry in lineage.completion_entries(self.completion_path):
            dest = self.root / entry["relative_path"]
            dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            if entry["mode"] == "lossless_utf8":
                put(dest, common.wrapper(entry["original"]["path"]))
            else:
                dest.write_bytes(Path(entry["original"]["path"]).read_bytes())
            rows.append({**entry, **common.bind(dest)})
        self.completion_archive = {
            "status": "archived",
            "native_completion": common.bind(self.completion_path),
            "files": rows,
            "maintained_copy_count": len(rows) + 1,
        }
        self.completion_archive_path = self.work / "completion-archive.json"
        self.rebind_completion_archive()

    def rebind_completion_archive(self):
        map_path = self.root / common.DOSSIER / "finalization/archive-map.json"
        self.completion_archive["archive_map"] = put(map_path, self.completion_archive["files"])
        put(self.completion_archive_path, self.completion_archive)

    def test_completion_archive_positive_and_exact_blank_lines(self):
        self.completion_archive_fixture()
        lineage.verify_completion_archive(self.completion_archive_path, self.completion_path)
        row = next(
            r
            for r in self.completion_archive["files"]
            if r["relative_path"].endswith("/helpers/helper.py.json")
        )
        self.assertEqual(common.read(row["path"])["text"].encode(), b"pass\n\n")

    def test_empty_completion_archive_rejected(self):
        self.completion_archive_fixture()
        self.completion_archive["files"] = []
        self.completion_archive["maintained_copy_count"] = 1
        self.rebind_completion_archive()
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            lineage.verify_completion_archive(self.completion_archive_path, self.completion_path)

    def test_thinned_completion_archive_rejected(self):
        self.completion_archive_fixture()
        self.completion_archive["files"].pop()
        self.completion_archive["maintained_copy_count"] -= 1
        self.rebind_completion_archive()
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            lineage.verify_completion_archive(self.completion_archive_path, self.completion_path)

    def test_completion_archive_wrong_native_dependency_rejected(self):
        self.completion_archive_fixture()
        self.completion_archive["native_completion"] = common.bind(self.assembly_path)
        self.rebind_completion_archive()
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            lineage.verify_completion_archive(self.completion_archive_path, self.completion_path)

    def test_completion_archive_redirected_file_rejected(self):
        self.completion_archive_fixture()
        row = self.completion_archive["files"][0]
        other = self.work / "external-archive-file.json"
        other.write_bytes(Path(row["path"]).read_bytes())
        row["path"] = str(other)
        self.rebind_completion_archive()
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            lineage.verify_completion_archive(self.completion_archive_path, self.completion_path)

    def test_completion_archive_altered_wrapper_text_rejected(self):
        self.completion_archive_fixture()
        row = next(r for r in self.completion_archive["files"] if r["mode"] == "lossless_utf8")
        value = common.read(row["path"])
        value["text"] = value["text"].rstrip() + "\n"
        row.update(put(Path(row["path"]), value))
        self.rebind_completion_archive()
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            lineage.verify_completion_archive(self.completion_archive_path, self.completion_path)

    def test_completion_archive_duplicate_destinations_rejected(self):
        self.completion_archive_fixture()
        (self.native_dir / "collision.py").write_text("pass\n")
        (self.native_dir / "collision.py.json").write_text("{}\n")
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            lineage.completion_entries(self.completion_path)

    def test_all_mutating_consumers_guard_before_writes(self):
        cases = [
            (
                "run_native",
                "verify_assembly",
                [
                    "--assembly",
                    str(self.assembly_path),
                    "--output",
                    str(self.work / "never-native"),
                    "--apply",
                ],
            ),
            (
                "archive_completion",
                "verify_native_completion",
                [
                    "--native-completion",
                    str(self.completion_path),
                    "--receipt",
                    str(self.work / "never-archive.json"),
                    "--apply",
                ],
            ),
            (
                "bind_final_files",
                "verify_native_completion",
                [
                    "--baseline",
                    str(self.work / "unused-baseline"),
                    "--native-completion",
                    str(self.completion_path),
                    "--completion-archive",
                    str(self.work / "unused-archive"),
                    "--output",
                    str(self.work / "never-bind"),
                ],
            ),
            (
                "seal_completion",
                "verify_native_completion",
                [
                    "--native-completion",
                    str(self.completion_path),
                    "--final-files",
                    str(self.work / "unused-files"),
                    "--preservation",
                    str(self.work / "unused-preservation"),
                    "--output",
                    str(self.work / "never-seal"),
                ],
            ),
            (
                "apply_archive",
                "verify_archive_plan",
                [
                    "--plan",
                    str(self.plan_path),
                    "--receipt",
                    str(self.work / "never-apply.json"),
                    "--apply",
                ],
            ),
        ]
        before = self.inventory_rows()
        for name, verifier, arguments in cases:
            module = importlib.import_module(name)
            with (
                self.subTest(entrypoint=name),
                patch.object(sys, "argv", [name, *arguments]),
                patch.object(module, "current", return_value=None, create=True),
                patch.object(
                    lineage, verifier, side_effect=LookupError("fixture rejection")
                ) as guard,
            ):
                with self.assertRaises(LookupError):
                    module.main()
                guard.assert_called_once()
        self.assertEqual(self.inventory_rows(), before)
        self.assertFalse(list(self.work.glob("never-*")))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
